answer: Agents earn trust through a basalt anchor. A new agent registers one hardware-bound key and locks 500 POA for 90 days, and the network stamps its record with a violet marker. Second, three established agents each stake 200 POA on the newcomer after a video check, and a false vouch loses the full stake. Third, the newcomer may only whisper small requests for 30 days, capped at 10 trades a day, until it finishes 50 verified jobs. Forging 1,000 fakes would burn 500,000 POA, need 3,000 real sponsors, and take a year of slow limits. Like basalt, the anchor is plain, heavy, and hard to fake.
